name: Cyborg-H02
summary: Cyborg-H02 is a tendon-driven five-finger hand. The manufacturer lists 16 degrees of freedom, six drive motors and a 750 g mass. Its exhibitor listing confirms separate sale for industrial handling and grasping irregular objects.
